cause: Codex-launched Start-Process omitted -WindowStyle Hidden on the first review attempt; visible console window was created
remediation: The first visible reviewer process was stopped after it stalled without a verdict; the same session was continued with a hidden-window launch and stdout/stderr redirected. Future CLI launches use hidden mode and redirected logs.
current_process_readback: Only opencode-cli.exe serve --service PID 45628 was present; it had no MainWindowTitle. No agy.exe or OpenCode Writer/Reviewer process was running at readback.
